data_fields.name: always_layer_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 (body, hand1, leg, boots, hair are always rolled)

data_fields.name: seeded_pick_small_count_result
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 when the count is below 2, else hash mod count

data_fields.name: ghost_fill_first_layer_index
data_fields.donor_constant: layers from cloak upward (index 5 in the roll order) are seeded

best_idea: A look is a set of layers, each with a chance (always, coin flip, one in four), and a layer the species or job did not set takes a seeded pick so the same name always looks the same.
decision_why: Frankendom wants a seed-stable look for NPCs and fallen heroes on the shared rig; the donor's chance table and seeded pick fit, but its roll has no species check, so a per-species range table is added. The random roll stays for the creator only.
acceptance: A fallen NPC with the same name shows the same layer ids on two visits (a server test asserts identical ids for one seed), and a species with no beard range never rolls a beard (a test asserts it).
